# MRI language test fixtures

These files are the `.rb` test suite from MRI Ruby's `test/ruby/` directory.

- **Source:** <https://github.com/ruby/ruby> (`test/ruby/`)
- **License:** Ruby license or 2-clause BSD — see [LICENSE-ruby](../../../../LICENSE-ruby) at repo root
- **Copyright:** Yukihiro Matsumoto and contributors

These fixtures are used as integration-test smoke tests for the goruby
lexer, parser, and AST walker. They are committed verbatim (not fetched)
and are not modified except to track upstream changes.
